description: FAO Food Price Index monthly values (2002-2004 = 100) from the FAO CSV: overall index plus meat, dairy, cereals, oils and sugar sub-indices, latest months first. The published file currently ends in March 2018, so the tool reports that date rather than a newer month. Choose this tool for: FAO Food Price Index monthly values from the FAO CSV. Close alternatives on this server: energy_pulp_paper_risi_index (US producer price index for wood pulp, monthly index value); energy_steel_rebar_hrc_futures (US producer price index for steel mill products, monthly). Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
